data.title: 爱夏·花廊下的回眸
data.action: 抬手扶住头纱边缘，转头望向镜头
data.description: 花廊下，爱夏身体朝向石径，转头望向镜头，一只手轻扶被微风带起的头纱边缘，另一只手自然垂在腰侧。象牙白蕾丝长袖与象牙白腰带呼应白色发带。镜头取至大腿上部，白花只沿画面两侧形成边框，夕阳透过头纱，脸部保留柔和反光。
data.promptProse: She catches the wind-lifted veil with one hand, the other at her waist, and looks back beneath the arbor. White flowers frame the sides; low sunlight passes through the veil while soft reflected light reaches her face.
data.animaCaption: One hand catches the veil; the other rests at her waist.
